name: silver-cc-tools
description: Personal collection of Claude Code agents and skills.

plugins.name: decide
plugins.description: Decision gates: interviewing the owner for what they actually want, and briefing the owner before they pick between design forks.

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Finalize a feature branch: rebase onto default, squash, verify, and optionally force-push.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Research topics online via web search and page fetching.

plugins.name: basedpyright-lsp
plugins.description: Python language server (basedpyright) for Claude: diagnostics + navigation, resolved from the project venv first so it matches the type-check gate.

plugins.name: pyrefly-lsp
plugins.description: Python language server (pyrefly) for Claude: diagnostics + navigation, resolved from the project venv first so it matches the type-check gate. Alternative to basedpyright-lsp — enable only one.

plugins.name: tracking
plugins.description: Lightweight project-state tracking: a deferred-work backlog under docs/backlog/, one slug-named file per item.

plugins.name: huddle
plugins.description: Ask the user as a page in an agterm overlay: visual options, side-by-side trade-offs, real code from disk, sliders with a live preview, several questions with a review. Needs agterm 0.34+ and Python 3.

plugins.name: peer-planning
plugins.description: Plan with coarse tasks for high-effort executors, then execute each task with Codex in the adjacent agterm pane: agree the approach, implement through a subagent, review, clear. Needs agterm, its two-agent-chat recipe, Codex and revmux.

plugins.name: output-styles
plugins.description: Claude Code output styles: Direct — peer-to-peer tone, plain English, choice-first, diagrams-first.
